Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap and draft MAP. A few items from our side:

- PHI/PII: We will not send raw PHI to hosted endpoints. Planned approach is to use tokenized/hashed patient identifiers for model inputs. We may require PHI workflows later for a pilot, at which point a BAA and Private or Dedicated deployment will likely be necessary.
- Retention: Our baseline requirement is audit logs and access logs retained for 3 years for regulated workflows; application-level data retention we can discuss (3 years preferred, flexible for initial pilot).
- Audit trails: We need ability to export audit logs (readable CSV or S3 export), and timestamped record of requester (user id) and API call context.
- SOC2: Please share your latest SOC2 Type II report and controls matrix.

We are aiming for a target close by end of Q2 as you noted, pending evidence and BAA discussion. Our IT/security team (copied) will route the questionnaire and follow up with any clarifying Qs.

Marissa / team,

Thanks for the ping and the context. Responses below referencing the MAP items:

1) SOC2 Type II and controls matrix
- We can share our SOC2 Type II 2025 report and a controls mapping document. I attached a redacted copy for initial review. Full evidence can be shared under NDA.
- Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-TypeII-2025.pdf (pdf stub)

2) BAA and PHI handling
- We do support BAA execution for Dedicated and Private deployments; for hosted public API we require an enterprise contract and legal approval. For customers planning to process PHI, we recommend Dedicated or Private with customer-managed KMS and audit logging enabled.

3) Retention and logging
- Default platform retention for request logs is 90 days. We offer extended log retention as an add-on; we can support up to 3 years via archival to a customer-owned S3 bucket or our long-term storage add-on.
- Export: logs can be exported as compressed JSON/CSV to S3 or downloaded via the Console. We also provide an audit-log query API for ad-hoc export. Sample schema included in the controls doc.

4) Audit trails / schema
- Logs include timestamp, request id, caller identity (API key or user id), model id, route, and masked input indicators. We do not store raw inputs for customers that opt into our input-redaction mode; inputs can be configured to be redacted or not based on customer preference and contract.

5) Action items and owners (proposed)
- Jonas Weber: Share SOC2 packet and controls matrix with Acme by 2026-03-09.
- Rishi Malhotra: Confirm BAA terms and signability for Dedicated/Private vs hosted by 2026-03-10.
- Dev Patel: Provide retention pricing and export instructions by 2026-03-12.

I will join the call with Acme IT to walk through the logging schema. We can provide a brief tech slide deck for the call to make the options concrete.

Let me know if we should escalate to Legal now for any unusual clause in their questionnaire.

Jonas Weber
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
